items.title: Respecting Intellectual Property and Data Ownership

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Respecting Intellectual Property and Data Ownership under 9.5 as printed (PDF 135, printed 131).

blocks.text: Intellectual property refers to creative work such as software, music, or writing. Data ownership refers to the right to control personal information. Respecting these rights means avoiding copying, sharing, or using work without permission. Personal and sensitive information should be protected and not misused. Legal and ethical respect for intellectual property and data encourages fairness and protects creators and users.
